name: app.spec
description: App Studio SUB criterion for the intake-spec stage: is this app spec ready to build from? Checks that every feature row carries a source (video timestamp, document section, user quote, reference screen), acceptance tests are executable, what done looks like is shown, and out-of-scope is named. Used together with plan.readiness; both must clear 0.9 before scaffolding. ADVISORY AND UNCALIBRATED until calibrated on labelled specs.

features_cited.instructions: Each feature row names where it came from - a video timestamp, a document section, a quote from the requester, or a reference screen - rather than being asserted

acceptance_executable.instructions: Acceptance criteria are executable checks: a command with expected output, a route with expected response, or a UI step with the expected screen - not adjectives like fast, clean, or intuitive

done_looks_like.instructions: The spec shows what done looks like: named screens, routes, or reference images of the finished app

out_of_scope_named.instructions: The spec names what is explicitly out of scope for this build

invented_features.instructions: The spec contains features, integrations, or numbers with no stated source that look invented to fill space

readiness.instructions: How ready is this spec to hand to a builder agent unattended
criteria: Features sourced and acceptance defined, edges ambiguous
Sourced, executable acceptance, done-screens and out-of-scope all present

rules.reason: acceptance is not executable: the builder has nothing to be graded against
unsourced features: drop them or mark them speculative
spec not ready for an unattended build
no picture of done: name the screens or routes
